07_samples_quarterly_label2: These quarterly counts are the denominator for every per-1,000 rate that follows. Median complete quarter: 132 samples.
11_sensations_label: Reported on 2,363 consumed samples (consumed = "taken"); 27 distinct sensation terms.
11_sensations_label2: Also derived: sen_strength (weaker / normal / stronger), sen_up, sen_down, sen_skin, sen_seizure, sen_burn. Top term: stronger.
12_overdose_label: overdose-involved samples per 1,000 with reported involvement, 2026Q3 — 896 samples (29%) did not report, and are excluded from the denominator
